items.title: Index SLM Technical Report
items.title_zh: Index SLM 技术报告：Bilibili 开源 19 亿参数小模型系列
items.summary: Index-1.9B is a family of four open small language models from Bilibili, including a base model pre-trained on 2.8 trillion predominantly Chinese and English tokens, an instruction-filtered Pure variant, a Chat model aligned with SFT and DPO, and a Character model that adds retrieval-augmented generation for few-shot role-playing. Index-1.9B-Base averages 64.92 on standard examination, reasoning, math and code benchmarks, and all models and evaluation code are released.

items.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: FlashTrie：面向生成式检索的 GPU 加速约束束搜索
items.summary: FlashTrie moves constrained beam search for generative retrieval onto GPUs with an integer-aware succinct trie that bit-compresses the index into high-bandwidth memory and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation and pruning on-device. On a library of 800 million keywords with beam widths up to 1,000, it is reported to cut trie-search latency below 3 ms with up to 24x speedup over a multithreaded CPU baseline, alongside a 0.71% revenue lift in an online A/B test.

items.title: Prompting-MammAlps: Fine-Grained Text-to-Video Retrieval for Camera-Trap Data
items.title_zh: Prompting-MammAlps：面向相机陷阱数据的细粒度文本到视频检索
items.summary: The paper introduces Prompting-MammAlps, described as the first camera-trap text-to-video retrieval benchmark, and a fine-grained method that converts spatiotemporal action-localization output into structured text that an LLM coding agent parses to retrieve videos. The approach reaches a set-based F1 of 34% on 135 ecological queries and 775 candidate videos, versus 18% for the best zero-shot VLM, while remaining interpretable.

items.title: SAGEAgent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Cost-Aware Modality Acquisition in Multimodal Survival Prediction
items.title_zh: SAGEAgent：面向多模态生存预测成本感知模态获取的自进化智能体
items.summary: SAGEAgent is a self-evolving LLM clinical agent that treats diagnostic modality acquisition as a sequential decision problem, using tools that translate predictions into text plus episodic and semantic memories to decide which diagnostic modalities are worth acquiring. On a glioma cohort with four modalities it achieves competitive survival prediction accuracy while reducing average acquisition burden by 55%.

items.title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
items.title_zh: 面向 QANTA 2026 的多模态问答智能体：置信度校准与增量推理
items.summary: The paper describes a two-agent system for the QANTA 2026 multimodal quizbowl challenge: a Tossup agent with confidence-calibrated answering and a domain-specific numeric reasoning policy, and a Bonus agent using leadin-aware and structured relational reasoning with multimodal evidence. It reports the highest overall leaderboard score of 0.402, with a Tossup score of 0.238 and a Bonus Effect score of 0.164, without a retrieval pipeline or model ensembles.

items.title: A Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Security Control Recommendation
items.title_zh: 面向安全控制推荐的知识型多智能体框架
items.summary: The paper proposes a security decision support system that recommends security control sub-families from minimal coverage requirements, modeled as a non-zero-sum simultaneous game grounded in a Multi-Agent Influence Diagram over seven security dimensions and solved with no-regret online learning. It reports 99% satisfaction coverage using about 65% of software-implementable controls and 73%–77% coverage using about 29%, running in roughly 0.8 to 35.7 seconds.

items.title: ShenSeanChen/waku-agent
items.title_zh: ShenSeanChen/waku-agent：可完全自有的本地 AI 智能体框架
items.summary: waku-agent is a local-first AI agent harness in Python that users own outright, bundling the agent loop, memory and evaluation in code intended to stay legible as it grows.

items.title: Why write code in 2026
items.summary: The author argues that engineers' job is now to build the software factory itself — the prompts, knowledge bases and automated evaluation that let agents ship changes safely.
